headline: LAD @ MIN matchup research

Batter research is strongest for Josh Bell, Byron Buxton, Mookie Betts, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Austin Martin, Alex Freeland because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
